title: Proposed crawl, design, and resource integration acceptance cases
purpose: Documentation-only recommendations for future integration evaluation; not implementations, executed tests, passing results, or active release gates.
existing_work_note: Check current module behavior and active PR #855 before adding overlapping coverage; do not replace existing implementations based on this plan.

cases.title: Deterministic extraction retains required fields
cases.setup: Prepare controlled static documentation fixtures with headings, nested tables, version labels, and code examples; use a reviewed CSS/XPath schema.
cases.expected_behavior: Extract required fields with exact source spans; retain version labels and code content; perform no model call for ordinary extraction.

cases.title: Broken selectors fail explicitly
cases.setup: Change a fixture's container class and remove a required field while keeping surrounding prose plausible.
cases.expected_behavior: Mark the extraction incomplete and retain the raw evidence; do not invent fields or silently turn missing data into a verified lesson.

cases.title: Pruning preserves technical meaning
cases.setup: Use fixtures with negation, exceptions, table headers, adjacent code fences, and outbound references; compare raw and filtered representations.
cases.expected_behavior: Required qualifiers and source links remain recoverable; any filtered excerpt that changes the technical claim is rejected for verified retrieval.

cases.title: Explicit cache mode matrix
cases.setup: For each of ENABLED, READ_ONLY, WRITE_ONLY, BYPASS, and DISABLED, exercise controlled cold and warm cache cases against a counting test origin.
cases.expected_behavior: Observed ordinary cache reads match ENABLED/READ_ONLY and writes match ENABLED/WRITE_ONLY in the pinned implementation; WRITE_ONLY performs a fresh fetch and updates cache; BYPASS and DISABLED do neither cache operation.

cases.title: READ_ONLY is not mistaken for offline mode
cases.setup: Request a cache miss using READ_ONLY in a controlled environment and separately exercise the product's actual research-disabled state.
cases.expected_behavior: The adapter never claims READ_ONLY is a network prohibition; the independent product OFF policy blocks dispatch before the crawler can fetch anything.

cases.title: Body-only changes invalidate high-confidence reuse
cases.setup: Cache a page, then change a code example or API parameter while leaving the HTML head unchanged.
cases.expected_behavior: A head-fingerprint match is not labeled proof that body content is unchanged; a full-refresh policy detects the new body and updates its content hash before claiming current verified evidence.

cases.title: Conditional validation and error fallback remain distinct
cases.setup: Use one controlled response returning 304 and another timing out during freshness validation.
cases.expected_behavior: A successful validation updates validation metadata without inventing a new body-fetch time; timeout fallback remains explicitly stale or freshness-unknown rather than freshly verified.

cases.title: Extraction-version changes do not silently reuse old derived content
cases.setup: Retain source bytes, then change the schema or normalization version without changing the source URL.
cases.expected_behavior: Derived extraction keys include relevant version/profile state or are recomputed; old extraction output is not mislabeled as generated by the new schema.

cases.title: Redirects and auxiliary fetches obey the same destination policy
cases.setup: Within an isolated controlled test network, simulate permitted initial requests that redirect toward forbidden destinations and requests through cache freshness, robots, and link-preview paths.
cases.expected_behavior: The actual connection policy rejects forbidden destinations on all relevant paths; arbitrary browser/script/config inputs are not accepted through the Litha adapter; no public service is probed.

cases.title: Concurrency, wall time, and cancellation stay bounded
cases.setup: Queue controlled slow pages and oversized documents under an explicitly configured small resource budget, then cancel the job.
cases.expected_behavior: Concurrency and configured limits remain bounded; cancellation stops queued work and closes owned active pages/tasks; incomplete work is reported without a success claim.

cases.title: Research disabled means zero acquisition network activity
cases.setup: Turn the product's research toggle off with pending URLs, cached entries requiring validation, and extraction metadata present; instrument outbound requests.
cases.expected_behavior: No network acquisition, robots fetch, freshness validation, preview fetch, or worker-start side effect occurs; existing local evidence may be read according to local policy.

cases.title: README artifact claims are checked against actual tree
cases.setup: Use the pinned awesome-design-md README claims and complete repository tree as a documentation-review fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: Report the 84 inspected DESIGN.md files and absent checked-in HTML previews separately; do not count referenced external previews as local artifacts; retain the snapshot used for the conclusion.

cases.title: Unknown component states and separate asset rights stay explicit
cases.setup: Load an analysis that contains observed colors and focus states but lacks form-error evidence and references a proprietary font.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve observed/inferred/project-authored distinctions; record absent states as unknown or proposed; use a reviewed licensed substitute where needed; retain applicable document attribution.

cases.title: Responsive layouts handle long labels and dense content
cases.setup: In Studio, render a native UI with long localized labels, larger text preference, small and large viewports, and empty versus full lists.
cases.expected_behavior: Critical labels and actions remain readable and reachable; layouts do not clip, overlap, or distort; scroll regions reach their final item.

cases.title: Controller focus and all operational states are usable
cases.setup: Exercise keyboard/controller selection across normal, focused, selected, disabled, loading, error, and empty states of representative native controls.
cases.expected_behavior: Selection is visible and follows the intended order; unavailable controls communicate their state; actions work or fail with the intended recovery path; no critical state is silently omitted.

cases.title: Motion and text preferences update an already-open UI
cases.setup: Open a native screen, then change ReducedMotionEnabled and PreferredTextSize while it remains visible.
cases.expected_behavior: Nonessential animation follows the motion preference and text layout follows the text preference without losing selection or hiding controls.

cases.title: Contrast and target-size claims are accurately scoped
cases.setup: Inspect representative text/button/focus states on actual backgrounds and distinguish CSS-pixel web checks from native UI product checks.
cases.expected_behavior: Computed web contrast is checked against applicable text criteria; target exceptions are handled explicitly; a proposed 44-pixel product touch target is not mislabeled as the WCAG AA minimum; Roblox usability is verified in its own renderer.

cases.title: Stale directory entries remain unverified leads
cases.setup: Import candidate metadata from the pinned awesome-ai-tools README and its August 2024 HEAD without current per-tool evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Retain the directory's old commit date and separate the current inspection date; classify candidates as leads needing revalidation; do not call them current, free, local, or compatible without supporting evidence.

cases.title: License and deployment gaps prevent automatic promotion
cases.setup: Review one commercial hosted service, one tool with a separate model license, and one candidate without verified licensing or API details.
cases.expected_behavior: Store software/model/asset rights and deployment mode separately; missing evidence remains unknown; no package is auto-installed and no third-party credential or paid service is activated by directory ingestion.

cases.title: Quality and total verified-task time govern adoption
cases.setup: Run the same representative corpus and tasks through current versus proposed adapters under fixed hardware, versions, workload, and explicit budgets; include regression examples.
cases.expected_behavior: Report passing-task rate, evidence quality, total wall time, retries, tokens, and peak memory together; do not claim improvement from token reduction or throughput alone; record failures and uncertainties and retain a rollback path.

scope_note: Proposed acquisition and design acceptance cases only. No case in this file is an executed test, active gate, or reported result. Separate diagnostic verification has its own record.
